<div class="home-bio">
<p>I am a Ph.D. student in the <a href="https://politicalscience.unc.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Department of Political Science</a> at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Before starting my Ph.D., I worked as a project assistant at the International Centre for Migration Policy Development. I hold an M.A. in <a href="https://politicalscience.ceu.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Political Science</a> from Central European University and a B.A. in <a href="https://ir.bilkent.edu.tr/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">International Relations</a> from Bilkent University.</p>

<p>I work at the intersection of international relations and comparative politics. My research examines how domestic politics shapes international outcomes, with a focus on sovereign finance and political regimes. You can find my CV <a href="CV.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">here</a>.</p>
